name: Grand Fisher
title: Lure
description: After 10 seconds without a lure, summons LURE with Taunt and one quarter of the boss’s stats. It can attack and must be defeated before the boss can be targeted again.

name: Kurama
title: Tailed Beast Bomb
description: Every 5 seconds, hits all enemies for 2.5 times the damage of a normal attack.

name: Gun Devil
title: Gun Fiend
description: Once on death, takes the player’s weakest member by base BST (first slot on ties) and returns at full HP. Uses the host’s current stats plus 50% of the boss’s stats. The host leaves the player’s side for this battle only.

name: Mahoraga
title: Adaptation
description: After being affected by an ability once, becomes immune to that ability.

name: Deoxys
title: Form Change
description: Starts in Normal Forme and switches to a different random forme every 3 seconds. Attack: +60 ATK, −60 DEF. Defense: +80 DEF, −80 ATK. Speed: +60 SPD, −30 ATK and DEF. Changes replace the previous forme’s bonuses.

name: Sahaquiel
title: 10th Angel
description: Does not attack. At 20 seconds, kills every player unit and ends the battle in defeat. Defeat it before the countdown reaches zero. Time stop does not pause this countdown.
